product_overview: This backend supports account registration, email verification, login sessions, and password recovery for the identity context. It also includes the tenancy and configuration APIs needed for organization onboarding and tenant-scoped setup where implemented.
core_goals: Allow visitors to register accounts with email verification before activation
Provide centralized authentication with session cookie-based login/logout and current-user lookup
Support password reset via emailed code
Enable authenticated users to create and manage organizations and memberships
Provide tenant-scoped configuration CRUD for payment and workflow setup

features.name: User registration & email verification
features.description: Lets a visitor create an account, request a verification code, and verify the email address to activate the account.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with fullName, email, phone, and password -> Receive 201 with userId and email -> POST /api/auth/request-verification-code with the registered email -> Receive 200 message confirming code delivery -> POST /api/auth/verify-email with email and valid 6-digit code -> Receive 200 message and account becomes active
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 duplicate email
POST /api/auth/verify-email with email and invalid or expired code -> Receive 400 invalid or expired code

features.name: Login, session & password reset
features.description: Authenticates verified users, issues an httpOnly JWT cookie, exposes the current session user, and supports password recovery.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with verified email and correct password -> Receive 200 with userId, email, and fullName -> httpOnly erp_auth cookie is set -> GET /api/auth/me with the session cookie -> Receive 200 with current user details -> POST /api/auth/logout -> Receive 200 message and session cookie is cleared
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials or unverified email -> Receive 401 invalid credentials or unverified email

POST /api/auth/forgot-password with an unknown email -> Receive 200 message if accepted by policy or 404 unknown email where applicable -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with email, invalid/expired code, and newPassword -> Receive 400 invalid or expired code

features.name: Organization & membership
features.description: Creates organizations, checks workspace availability, lists the caller's organizations and requests, and supports invitation and acceptance flows.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/workspace-name-availability?workspaceName=acme -> Receive 200 with isAvailable boolean -> POST /api/organizations with organization profile, feature selections, and unique workspaceName -> Receive 201 with organizationId, name, and workspaceName -> GET /api/organizations/mine -> Receive 200 with organizations, requests, and invitations arrays

POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/invitations with email and role as an authorized admin -> Receive 200 with membershipId, email, and role -> POST /api/organizations/memberships/{membershipId}/accept-invitation as the invited user -> Receive 200 message confirming membership acceptance
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/invitations with email and role when caller lacks permission -> Receive 403 caller lacks InviteUser permission
POST /api/organizations/memberships/{membershipId}/accept-request without AcceptRequest permission -> Receive 403 caller lacks AcceptRequest permission

features.name: Configuration - Credit Terms
features.description: Provides tenant-scoped CRUD for named payment due-day terms such as Net 30.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms with a permitted user -> Receive 200 with credit term list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms with name and dueDays -> Receive 201 with created credit term -> PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms/{id} with updated name, dueDays, and isActive -> Receive 200 with updated credit term -> DELETE /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms/{id} -> Receive 204 deleted
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms with a duplicate name in the same organization -> Receive 409 duplicate name
GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms with a user lacking View permission -> Receive 403 caller lacks View permission

features.name: Configuration - Payment Modes
features.description: Provides tenant-scoped CRUD for payment mode definitions such as Cash or Bank Transfer.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes -> Receive 200 with payment mode list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes with name -> Receive 201 with created payment mode -> PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes/{id} with name and isActive -> Receive 200 with updated payment mode -> DELETE /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes/{id} -> Receive 204 deleted
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes with a duplicate name -> Receive 409 duplicate name
GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/payment-modes with insufficient permission -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Configuration - Custom Statuses
features.description: Provides tenant-scoped CRUD for custom document statuses tied to a specific document type.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses -> Receive 200 with custom status list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses with name and documentType -> Receive 201 with created status -> PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses/{id} with updated name, documentType, and isActive -> Receive 200 with updated status -> DELETE /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses/{id} -> Receive 204 deleted
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses with duplicate name for the same documentType -> Receive 409 duplicate name for that document type
GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-statuses with insufficient permission -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Configuration - Reporting Tag Categories & Options
features.description: Provides CRUD for reporting tag categories and their child options within a tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-categories -> Receive 200 with category list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-categories with name -> Receive 201 with created category -> GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-options -> Receive 200 with option list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-options with name and categoryId -> Receive 201 with created option -> PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-options/{id} with updated name, categoryId, and isActive -> Receive 200 with updated option
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-options with a missing or invalid categoryId -> Receive 404 category not found
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/reporting-tag-categories with a duplicate name in the organization -> Receive 409 duplicate name

features.name: Configuration - Custom Field Definitions
features.description: Provides CRUD for EAV field definitions, including type and applicable document types, before field values are supported.
user_flows: GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions -> Receive 200 with custom field definition list -> POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions with name, type, and applicableDocumentTypes -> Receive 201 with created definition -> PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions/{id} with updated properties -> Receive 200 with updated definition -> DELETE /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions/{id} -> Receive 204 deleted
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions with no applicableDocumentTypes -> Receive 400 no applicableDocumentTypes provided
POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/custom-field-definitions with a duplicate name in the organization -> Receive 409 duplicate name

tech_stack: JWT bearer auth via httpOnly cookie

features.name: Health check
features.description: Liveness endpoint confirming the API is running.

endpoints.description: Returns service status

features.name: Organization & membership
features.description: Create an Organization (3-step wizard backed by one command), list the caller's organizations/requests/invitations, invite/accept users, check workspace-name availability.

endpoints.description: Debounced check whether a workspace (subdomain) name is available. Query string param workspaceName.

response_schema.200: isAvailable boolean

endpoints.description: Lists the caller's accepted organizations, pending join requests, and pending invitations

response_schema.200: organizations array, requests array, invitations array

endpoints.description: Creates an Organization + seeds TenantSettings/TenantSubscription + Admin membership for the creator (global permission, any authenticated user)

request_schema.body: name string, industry string, address string, accountingStartDate date, isVatRegistered boolean, workspaceName string, email string, phone string, panNumber string, website string, trackInventory boolean, multipleLocations boolean, multipleWarehouses boolean, multiCurrency boolean, manufacturing boolean, posRetail boolean, posRestaurant boolean

response_schema.201: organizationId string, name string, workspaceName string

endpoints.description: Invites a user to the organization by email + role (requires Tenancy.Organization.InviteUser permission)

response_schema.200: membershipId string, email string, role string

endpoints.description: Self-service accept of an invitation addressed to the caller

response_schema.200: Message

endpoints.description: Admin accepts a pending join request (requires Tenancy.Organization.AcceptRequest permission)

response_schema.200: Message

features.name: Configuration - Credit Terms
features.description: Tenant-scoped named payment due-day terms (e.g. Net 30), full CRUD. New in Phase 2.

endpoints.description: Lists all credit terms for the organization, ordered by name (requires Configuration.CreditTerm.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, organizationId, name, dueDays integer, isActive boolean, createdAt

endpoints.description: Creates a credit term; rejects a duplicate name within the same organization (requires Configuration.CreditTerm.Manage)

response_schema.201: id string, name string, dueDays integer

endpoints.description: Updates name/dueDays/isActive; rejects renaming to a name already used by another credit term in the org (requires Manage)

request_schema.body: name string, dueDays integer, isActive boolean

response_schema.200: id string, name string, dueDays integer, isActive boolean
response_schema.404: Not found (wrong id or wrong organizationId)

endpoints.description: Deletes a credit term (requires Manage)

features.name: Configuration - Payment Modes
features.description: Tenant-scoped named payment modes (Cash, Bank Transfer, ...), full CRUD. New in Phase 2.

endpoints.description: Lists payment modes for the organization (requires Configuration.PaymentMode.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, organizationId, name, isActive boolean, createdAt

endpoints.description: Creates a payment mode; rejects duplicate name within the org (requires Manage)
Updates name/isActive (requires Manage)

response_schema.200: id string, name string, isActive boolean

endpoints.description: Deletes a payment mode (requires Manage)

features.name: Configuration - Custom Statuses
features.description: Tenant-scoped named statuses, scoped to a single DocumentType (e.g. Invoice), full CRUD. New in Phase 2.

endpoints.description: Lists custom statuses for the organization (requires Configuration.CustomStatus.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, organizationId, name, documentType string, isActive boolean, createdAt

endpoints.description: Creates a custom status; name must be unique per (organization, documentType) (requires Manage). documentType is one of the DocumentType enum names, e.g. Invoice, PurchaseBill, Quotation.

response_schema.201: id string, name string, documentType string
response_schema.409: Duplicate name for that document type

endpoints.description: Updates name/documentType/isActive (requires Manage)

request_schema.body: name string, documentType string enum, isActive boolean

response_schema.200: id string, name string, documentType string, isActive boolean
response_schema.409: Duplicate name for that document type

endpoints.description: Deletes a custom status (requires Manage)

features.name: Configuration - Reporting Tag Categories & Options
features.description: Tenant-scoped reporting-tag category tree (Category -> Options); Options carry a CategoryId FK. Full CRUD. New in Phase 2.

endpoints.description: Lists reporting tag categories (requires Configuration.ReportingTagCategory.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, organizationId, name, isActive boolean, createdAt

endpoints.description: Creates a category; rejects duplicate name within the org (requires Manage)
Updates name/isActive (requires Manage)

response_schema.200: id string, name string, isActive boolean

endpoints.description: Deletes a category (requires Manage)
Lists reporting tag options (requires Configuration.ReportingTagOption.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, organizationId, name, categoryId, isActive boolean, createdAt

endpoints.description: Creates an option under an existing category; 404 if categoryId doesn't exist in the org; name unique per category (requires Manage)

response_schema.201: id string, name string, categoryId string

endpoints.description: Updates name/categoryId/isActive (requires Manage)

request_schema.body: name string, categoryId guid, isActive boolean

response_schema.200: id string, name string, categoryId string, isActive boolean

endpoints.description: Deletes an option (requires Manage)

features.name: Configuration - Custom Field Definitions
features.description: EAV field definitions (Name, Type, ApplicableDocumentTypes list) for later document types. Definition CRUD only -- values are not read/written yet. New in Phase 2.

endpoints.description: Lists custom field definitions (requires Configuration.CustomFieldDefinition.View)

response_schema.200: array of id, name, type string enum Text-Number-Description-Choices, applicableDocumentTypes list, isActive boolean

endpoints.description: Creates a definition; rejects duplicate name in org; requires at least one applicableDocumentTypes entry (requires Manage)

request_schema.body: name string, type string enum Text-Number-Description-Choices, applicableDocumentTypes non-empty list of DocumentType enum strings

response_schema.201: id string, name string, type string, applicableDocumentTypes list

endpoints.description: Updates name/type/applicableDocumentTypes/isActive (requires Manage)

request_schema.body: name string, type string enum, applicableDocumentTypes non-empty list, isActive boolean

response_schema.200: id string, name string, type string, applicableDocumentTypes list, isActive boolean

endpoints.description: Deletes a definition (requires Manage)

known_limitations.issue: All Configuration Manage/View permission checks throw ForbiddenException mapped to HTTP 403, so a Member without permission and a nonexistent organizationId are distinguishable only by response body, not status code alone.
known_limitations.impact: A test asserting 403 for unauthorized role must use a real Member-role session against a real organization, not a bogus organizationId.

known_limitations.issue: The local dev Api serves HTTPS on port 7104 with a self-signed ASP.NET Core dev certificate. HTTP clients that verify certificates by default, such as Python requests, will fail with SSLError unless certificate verification is disabled.
known_limitations.impact: Automated test runners must disable TLS verification, verify=False, when calling https://localhost:7104.

known_limitations.issue: CustomFieldValue, the EAV value side, has no API surface yet -- only CustomFieldDefinition is exposed.
known_limitations.impact: No endpoint exists to create or read a CustomFieldValue; do not generate tests expecting one.
